title: Gaja
desc: A cat and mouse chase ensues between Gaja and a rival faction leader over a few startling events. Gaja tries to protect his friend, Krishna, and his lover, Shwetha, who are being targeted.

title: Janumada Jodi
desc: A lovelorn village boy, Krishna, and a girl, Kanaka, cross all barriers of caste and tradition to unite in a meaningful manner.

title: Sye
desc: Prudhvi and Shashank are rugby players who despise each other. However, they join forces to defeat a politician who wants to confiscate their college's land.

title: Seetharamam
desc: Afreen, a Pakistani woman, heads to India in order to deliver a love letter written in 1965 to fulfill her grandfather's dying wish. However, the journey alters her life forever.

title: Akhanda
desc: When the nefarious Varadarajulu plans to attack Murali Krishna, an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva, Akhanda leaves no stone unturned to defeat the evil.
